lines.text: You're home alone. Your parents went out for dinner. They won't be back until midnight.
You head down the hallway to grab a snack... past the family photos.
Like you do every single day.
But tonight... something feels wrong.
The beach photo from last summer. You, Mom, Dad...
and way back, by the water... someone is standing there.
Tall. Way too thin. Its arms hang all the way down to its knees.
You've walked past this picture a thousand times. It was never there.
Next photo. Christmas. The living room.
There it is again. In the corner. Closer. Its head tilted... like it's listening.
Your last birthday. It's standing right behind your chair...
its long grey fingers resting on your shoulder.
And the last photo on the wall... you've never seen it before.
It's this hallway. Tonight. You, from behind... staring at the photos.
And it's not in this one.
You stare at the empty picture... and in the glass of the frame... you see a reflection.
Of the ceiling. Right above you.
Don't look up.
It's hanging there. Upside down.
Its grey skin sagging off its bones like a wet sheet. Its neck bent all the way back.
Its jaw hanging open... and something drips onto the floor next to you.
Its pitch-black eyes don't blink. Its fingers twitch... one joint at a time.
It only moves when you can't see it. And your phone battery... is at one percent.
You have two options.
Run for the front door. Ten steps through the dark hallway... right underneath it.
Or lock yourself in the bathroom right next to you. The light works in there... but your parents won't be home for two more hours.
What do you do? Front door, or bathroom? Tell me in the comments.
And did you spot it in the very first second? Watch again.
Follow... before it shows up in your photos too.
